categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in precision plastic components manufacturing, mold design and manufacturing, and electronic materials wholesale. Key product lines include smart mold systems, advanced material applications focusing on biodegradable and PCR eco-friendly plastics, next-generation communication smart devices (5G+/6G network equipment), consumer 3C electronics, medical and health technology, smart mobility devices, sustainable energy components, and smart electric tools. It also provides integrated services including mold design, surface treatment, painting, printing, secondary processing, and assembly.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies such as gas-assisted molding, water-based coating, in-mold decoration (IMD), micro-foaming molding, automated production, rapid heating and cooling mold temperature control, hydraulic and pneumatic sequential hot runner molds, two-color molding, high-gloss mirror surface finishing, full-electric high-speed thin-frame molding, automatic cleaning of glue frames, and environmentally friendly PCR material molding. It also develops lightweight composite materials and integrates digital manufacturing platforms for rapid prototyping and mass production.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves major customers in consumer 3C electronics, 5G network communication, smart home appliances, security products, outdoor electric tools, e-books, electronic shelf labels (ESL), AI smart devices, medical and health technology, smart mobility equipment, and new energy automotive parts. Key end markets include global brand manufacturers and system integrators in electronics, automotive, medical, and green energy sectors, with notable customers such as Xiaomi, Lenovo, and Asus.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates production bases in Taiwan, Mainland China (Suzhou, Anhui Chuzhou), and Vietnam (Hai Duong), forming a 'Taiwan-China-Vietnam' regional supply chain. It targets domestic markets in Taiwan and China as well as international markets including Europe, the US, and Southeast Asia. The company actively expands overseas production capacity to serve global customers and mitigate geopolitical risks.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on mold design and manufacturing, precision plastic injection molding, surface treatment, and assembly services. It acts as a key component supplier and contract manufacturer (EMS) for downstream brand owners and system integrators in electronics and automotive industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding niche markets, enhancing internationalization, and providing one-stop services centered on precision mold design and manufacturing. R&D focuses on advancing molding technologies (e.g., gas-assisted, IMD, micro-foaming), developing eco-friendly and lightweight materials, automating production, and digital transformation including Industry 4.0 and smart manufacturing. The company also emphasizes sustainable development through ESG initiatives, low-carbon processes, and green materials innovation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of precision plastic components, molds, and related assembly services. The company also earns from customized mold design and secondary processing services. It operates on a contract manufacturing and EMS model, supplying components to brand owners and system integrators globally.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company’s main competitor in the plastic molding and precision components sector is Ying Ji (3294 TT). Other potential competitors include Ying Hua (5392 TT), Dong Pu (3290 TT), Gu Song (3607 TT), and Ju Teng (9136 TT), though these competitors differ in product application and customer relationships. The company holds a leading position due to its comprehensive manufacturing resources, advanced technologies, and strong customer base.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported annual revenue of approximately NT$877 million, with a slight decline from the previous year. It experienced significant net losses due to increased costs and market competition, with a net loss of NT$203 million in 2024. The company maintains substantial production capacity with hundreds of molding machines ranging from 50T to 2800T. It is actively investing in R&D (~1.1% of revenue) and expanding production in Vietnam to support growth and mitigate risks.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through integrated one-stop solutions combining precision mold design, advanced plastic molding, surface finishing, and assembly. It emphasizes rapid development cycles, high-quality and high-precision products, eco-friendly materials, and smart manufacturing capabilities. Its strong technical expertise, extensive production capacity, and close collaboration with global brand customers enable it to deliver customized, innovative, and sustainable products that meet evolving market demands.
